user.title: Set up PHIL9000
user.description: Pick the entity types PHIL9000 should learn from. It only watches at first — nothing is ever acted on until you confirm a learned behaviour. You can add or exclude individual devices later in the integration's options.

error.no_entities: Pick at least one entity type to observe.

init.title: PHIL9000 settings
init.description: Analysis and notify settings. What PHIL9000 observes is managed in its panel.

data.agent_id: Conversation agent for pattern analysis (blank = default agent)
data.analysis_enabled: Run nightly pattern analysis (optional, off by default)
data.custom_prompt: Custom LLM prompt (blank = built-in). Wrap placeholder names in curly braces: summary (required), known, cap.

error.prompt_needs_summary: The custom prompt must contain the summary placeholder (the word summary inside curly braces) — that is where the entity history goes.
error.prompt_invalid: The custom prompt has stray or mismatched curly braces — check that summary, known and cap are each wrapped in their own pair.
